purpose: Synthetic assignment cell; not confidential customer CAD

conveyor.feed_policy: Belts continue moving; feeder only releases requested kits. Inactive station can run empty. Limit released plus accepted kits to five until a rejection requires a replacement.

kit.bottle_fixture: Bottle may be retained in a kit fixture; ring must remain a freely manipulated rigid body.

robot.default: Single arm on AMR; candidate selects documented robot model
robot.navigation: Known map allowed; localize, plan, move and dock using sensors. No robot teleportation.

timing.status: Proposed engineering target checked by timing budget, not a measured complete robot result
timing.cycle_definition: Kit bottle crosses work-entry line to the first independently verified 0.5 s released seating hold; downstream inspection time and station travel are separate.

interruptions.warning: Simulation acceptance behavior only; not a certified human-protective safety function.
interruptions.human_zone: Person within 1m of base footprint or inside active workstation interaction zone. Candidate documents zone geometry and sensor detection.
interruptions.resume: Explicitly clear/acknowledge interruption, reacquire or reject moving kit, preserve kit IDs and accepted counts.
